```{r}
funclist <- dir()
funclist <- funclist[funclist!="plots.Rmd"]
datalist <- list()


# Function to extract only the numbers between "/" and "." using sub()
extract_number <- function(path) {
  # Use sub() to capture only the numbers between "/" and "."
  extracted <- sub(".*/([0-9]+)\\..*", "\\1", path)
  return(as.numeric(extracted))  # Optionally, convert to numeric
}


for (i in 1:length(funclist)) {
  funcpath<- paste0("./",funclist[i])
  list_csv_files <- list.files(funcpath,pattern='*.csv')
  csvpath<- paste0(funcpath,"/",list_csv_files)
  df <- read_csv(csvpath, id = "file_name")
  
  df$file_name <- extract_number(df$file_name)
  colnames(df)[1:2] <- c("Parameter","No")
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(simulation = funclist[i])
  datalist[[i]]<-df
}

datalist[[3]]
```

## +-变化

```{r cars}
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)
library(readr) 
library(dplyr)
```

```{r}
#basename(list.dirs())

#namelist = c('aes','bfs','bitonicsort','conv2d','fir','floydwarshall','im2col','kmeans','matrixmultiplication','matrixtranspose','nbody','nw','pagerank','spmv','stencil2d')


changelist = c('aes','matrixtranspose','nbody','pagerank','spmv')

```

```{r}
# Load necessary libraries
combined_rows_all <- data.frame()
for (i in 1:5) {
  path <- paste0("./",changelist[1])
  # Define the path to your directory containing the files
  
  # List all files that match the patterns
  file_list <- list.files(path, pattern = "^(buildL1SReorderBuffer_WithBufferSize|benchmark).*\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
  
  # Initialize an empty data frame to store combined rows
  combined_rows <- data.frame()
  
  # Loop through each file
  for (file in file_list) {
    # Read the CSV file
    data <- read.csv(file, header = TRUE)[2,]
    
    data$filename <- basename(file)
    data$folder <- changelist[i]
    
    combined_rows <- rbind(combined_rows, data)
  }
  combined_rows_all <- rbind(combined_rows_all,combined_rows)
}


combined_rows_all$change_value <- ifelse(
  grepl("^benchmark", combined_rows_all$filename), 0,  # Assign 0 if the filename starts with "benchmark"
  ifelse(
    grepl("^buildL1SReorderBuffer_WithBufferSize\\+", combined_rows_all$filename),  # If filename starts with "buildL1SReorderBuffer_WithBufferSize+"
    as.numeric(sub("\\.csv$", "", sub("buildL1SReorderBuffer_WithBufferSize\\+", "", combined_rows_all$filename))),  # Remove ".csv" and extract the number after "+"
    ifelse(
      grepl("^buildL1SReorderBuffer_WithBufferSize\\-", combined_rows_all$filename),  # If filename starts with "buildL1SReorderBuffer_WithBufferSize-"
      as.numeric(sub("\\.csv$", "", sub("buildL1SReorderBuffer_WithBufferSize\\-", "-", combined_rows_all$filename))),  # Remove ".csv" and extract the number after "-"
      NA  # Default to NA for filenames not matching any pattern
    )
  )
)



ggplot(combined_rows_all, aes(x = factor(change_value), y = as.numeric(value), fill = folder)) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
  coord_flip() + # Flips the axes for a double-sided appearance
  scale_y_continuous(labels = abs, breaks = seq(-max(abs(data$value)), max(abs(data$value)), by = 5)) +
  labs(
    title = "Double-Sided Bar Chart",
    x = "Change Value",
    y = "Value"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )

```
